packageRules.description: This repo carries per-machine Talos patches and machine classes. A bad change here does not degrade an app — it can make a node unbootable. Rule #1 in particular: machine.install.extraKernelArgs permanently bricks these UKI-booting machines and needs onsite USB recovery. Nothing here is ever automerged, and every update needs an explicit click.
Rule #27 — major bumps are always separate, single-package PRs.
